core_meaning.primary_meaning: Galila is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Great, exalted, majestic”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: No verified lexical identification was established for Galila. Galila is a variant spelling of Arabic جليلة (Jalīla) 'great, exalted, majestic' (feminine of جليل Jalīl), from the root ج ل ل (j-l-l). The source supplied only the Latin string 'Galila' for the script form and glossed it 'joy, gladness, and grace' — that gloss belongs to a different root (ف ر ح) and has been replaced with the 'majestic' sense. No meaning is asserted, because asserting one would require inventing evidence.
